title: Your app owns identity; the model enforces access
assumptions: Diagram caption: Request-path-only view; responses are omitted, not absent. Only RLS-filtered rows return, then a separate LLM explains those rows.
The application zone denotes custom-software responsibility, not a network or hosting boundary. Existing login and entitlement resolution remain; end users need not exist in Entra.

RLS depends on the broker mandatorily attaching the fixed ExternalAppScope role and opaque application user key in roles/customData. Its certificate service principal is workspace Admin, not inherently row-restricted.
evidence_gaps: The supplied RLS proof covers 42 synthetic Import checks; production behavior is not established by that proof.
The full integrated IQ conversational path has not yet been demonstrated.
Actual application login and its end-to-end identity binding to broker requests have not yet been demonstrated.

nodes.label: Your application
nodes.notes: Keeps its existing login and entitlement resolver and supplies verified application context to the broker. End users need not exist in Entra; actual application login is not yet demonstrated.

nodes.label: AI query planner
nodes.notes: Uses live IQ GetSemanticModelSchema with delegated authentication plus an LLM to generate DAX. Schema retrieval provides planning metadata, not authorization. The planner cannot set authorization. IQ's native ExecuteQuery and ValueSearch are excluded.

nodes.label: Trusted query broker
nodes.notes: Custom identity-bound broker executes business queries through executeDaxQueries, supplying generated DAX in query, fixed ExternalAppScope in roles, and the opaque application user key in customData. It authenticates using a certificate service principal with workspace Admin to select roles. This credential is privileged, not inherently row-restricted; mandatory role/key attachment is essential to RLS. The API returns Apache Arrow and may include HTTP-200 error rowsets.

nodes.label: Semantic Model
nodes.notes: Enforces CUSTOMDATA-based RLS using the broker-attached ExternalAppScope role and opaque application user key. This request-path-only view omits, but does not eliminate, responses: only RLS-filtered rows return under the mandatory role/key contract, then a separate LLM explains those rows. That response and explanation path is not drawn. A 42-check synthetic Import RLS proof exists; the full integrated IQ conversational path is not yet demonstrated.
